verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              अथाब्रवीद्द्रौपदी राजपुत्री पृष्टा शिबीनां प्रवरेण तेन। अवेक्ष्य मन्दं प्रविमुच्य शाखां सङ्गृह्णती कौशिकमुत्तरीयम्॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : Being thus accosted that foremost of Shibi's race, the princess Draupadi, looking gently, leaving of the Kadamba branch and arranging her silken raiment, said,

verses.sanskrit: बुद्ध्याऽभिजानामि नरेन्द्रपुत्र न मादृशी त्वामभिभाष्टुमर्हति। न त्वेह वक्ताऽस्ति तवेह वाक्यमन्यो नरो वाऽप्यथवाऽपि नारी॥२॥
verses.english: I know it, O prince, that it is not proper for me to address you thus, there is no other man or woman who can speak with you.
verses.bhavadeepa: अथेति । शिबीनां शिबिवंश्यानां क्षत्रियाणाम् । मन्दं स्वैरम् । अवेक्ष्य सङ्कोच्य । तदेवाह विमुच्येति । कौशिकं कोशजम् ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: एका ह्यहं सम्प्रति तेन वाचं ददानि वै भद्र निबोध चेदम्। अहं ह्यरण्ये कथमेकमेका त्वामालपेयं निरता स्वधर्मे॥३॥
verses.english: I am alone here just now so I should speak, know, O gentle sir, being alone in this forest, I should not speak to you, remembering the practices of our sex.

verses.sanskrit: जानामि च त्वां सुरथस्य पुत्रं यं कोटिकास्येति विदुर्मनुष्याः। तस्मादहं शैब्य तथैव तुभ्यमाख्यामि बन्धून् प्रथितं कुलं च॥४॥
verses.english: I have learnt you to be the son of Suratha whom people know as Kotikasya; so O Shaivya, I shall tell you of my relations and illustrious race.

verses.sanskrit: अपत्यमस्मि द्रुपदस्य राज्ञः कृष्णेति मां शैब्य विदुर्मनुष्याः। साऽहं वृणे पञ्च जनान् पतित्वे ये खाण्डवप्रस्थगताः श्रुतास्ते॥५॥
verses.english: I am the daughter of the king Drupada, O Shaivya, people know me as Krishna; I have elected five men as my husbands of whom you may have heard while they were living in Khandavaprastha.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिरो भीमसेनार्जुनौ च माद्र्याश्च पुत्रौ पुरुषप्रवीरौ। ते मां निवेश्येह दिशश्चतस्रो विभज्य पार्था मृगयां प्रयाताः॥६॥
verses.english: Those foremost of men, Yudhishthira, Bhimasena, Arjuna and the two sons of Madri, leaving me hear and having assigned four quarters, have gone out on hunting.

verses.sanskrit: प्राचीं राजा दक्षिणां भीमसेनो जयः प्रतीचीं यमजावुदीचीम्। मन्ये तु तेषां रथसत्तमानां कालोऽभितः प्राप्त इहोपयातुम्॥७॥
verses.english: The king has gone to the east, Bhimasena towards the south, Arjuna to the west and the twin brothers towards the north. Me-thinks, the time of the arrival of those leading carwarriors, has come.

verses.sanskrit: संमानिता यास्यथ तैर्यथेष्टं विमुच्य वाहानवरोहयध्वम्। प्रियातिथिर्धर्मसुतो महात्मा प्रीतो भविष्यत्यभिवीक्ष्य युष्मान्॥८॥
verses.english: Do you get down and dismiss your carriage so that yet may go after receiving a befitting welcome from them. The high-souled son of Dharma is fond of guests and will, in sooth, be glad to see you.

verses.sanskrit: एतावदुक्त्वा द्रुपदात्मजा सा शैब्यात्मजं चन्द्रमुखी प्रतीता। विवेश तां पर्णशालां प्रशस्तां सञ्चिन्त्य तेषामतिथित्वमर्थे॥९॥
verses.english: Having thus addressed Shaivya's son, the daughter of Draupadi, with a face beautiful as the moon, remembering well the hospitable tendency of her husband, entered her spacious cottage.
